Home.StatsHeadlineAxes: {{count}} areas of engagement driving lasting impact
Home.PresentationTitle: Training, entrepreneurship and economic cooperation: diasporas, allies here and abroad
Home.PresentationParagraph1: 2025: a historic shift in development financing. Several indicators point to a significant decline in official development assistance. This contraction comes at a pivotal time, as youth unemployment, the rise of artificial intelligence, the ecological transition and food security call for new forms of collaboration based on innovation, knowledge sharing and strategic investment.
Home.PresentationParagraph2: Declining development assistance, increasingly skilled and entrepreneurial diasporas, and the need for more equitable North–South partnerships that value local expertise underpin the theme of the third FISD edition.
Home.PresentationParagraph3: FISD goes beyond a one-off event: it is a lasting ecosystem with follow-up mechanisms for post-forum activities and resources to support participants.
Home.PanelText: A lasting ecosystem to support initiatives and extend collaboration beyond the forum.
Home.ParticipantsTitle: Who takes part in the forum
Home.ParticipantsPhotoCaption: FISD's 2025 edition, bringing together associations, NGOs, academics, and public authorities.
Home.SpeakersDescription: The 2026 edition's speakers will be announced soon.
Home.PillarsIntro: Launched in 2024, FISD responds to a shared observation: a lack of structured, inclusive spaces connecting diasporas, international development actors, public authorities, local communities and decentralised territorial leaders. FISD builds a community of committed actors working towards more equitable, horizontal cooperation.
Home.ProgramIntro: Get ready for three days of strategic, transformative immersion, followed by exclusive post-forum activities designed to maximise the tangible outcomes of your participation.
Home.ProgramDay3: B&B meetings, field visit and closing ceremony

Conditions.HeroTitle: General terms of participation for FISD 2026
Conditions.HeroDescription: Please read the terms of participation carefully before reserving your spot.
Conditions.PresentationP1: FISD (International Forum for Solidarity and Development) is an annual event organized by Jeunes Solidaires Canada, a non-profit organization incorporated under the Canada Not-for-profit Corporations Act.
Conditions.PresentationP2: To register for the forum, every participant must read and accept the terms of participation and the registration procedures described below. Failure to comply with these terms may lead the organizer to refuse participation in the Forum.
Conditions.EligibilityItem1: Those who registered online and paid for their participation ticket.
Conditions.EligibilityItem2: Those invited by FISD (participants, panelists, exhibitors, partners, etc.), who reside in Canada or elsewhere in the world and wish to propose a topic related to the Forum's theme or propose a partnership.
Conditions.RegistrationItem1: To take part in the Forum, you must fill out the online registration form on FISD's official website.
Conditions.RegistrationItem2: Once the form is submitted, an email notification confirms that your registration has been received.
Conditions.RegistrationItem3: An official letter of invitation to the forum will be sent to you, including guidelines on the event's organization.
Conditions.RegistrationItem4: Registration fees are paid at the time of online registration, according to the terms listed on FISD's website.
Conditions.RegistrationItem5: Payment is made through the Zeffy ticketing platform.
Conditions.RegistrationItem6: Accepted payment methods include: debit card, Visa, MasterCard, Amex, etc.
Conditions.PaymentIssuesPrefix: If you run into payment issues, write to us at
Conditions.CancellationText: No refund will be issued if you cancel your registration, regardless of the reason. That said, in the event of cancellation, we guarantee access to certain online content during and after the Forum.
Conditions.ParticipantsItem1: Participants must show respect toward other participants, organizers, panelists and exhibitors.
Conditions.ParticipantsItem2: Inappropriate behaviour (harassment, sexism, discrimination, racism, physical violence, etc.) is prohibited. The organizer may exclude a participant from the forum without a refund in the event of such behaviour.
Conditions.ParticipantsItem3: Participants must comply with the safety measures put in place at the forum's venue.
Conditions.PanelistsItem1: Panelists must submit their speaking proposals through the forum's website.
Conditions.PanelistsItem2: Only panelists whose proposals are accepted will be contacted.
Conditions.PanelistsItem3: The organizer will get in touch with accepted panelists regarding the panel's format.
Conditions.PanelistsItem4: In the event of withdrawal, panelists must inform the organizer so that the necessary steps can be taken.
Conditions.PartnersItem1: Partners must commit to taking part in the Forum as sponsors or exhibitors.
Conditions.PartnersItem2: Any other initiative must be discussed in advance with the organizing committee's chair and receive their approval.
Conditions.PartnersItem3: A contract covering the terms of participation will be established between the partners and the Forum's organizer.
Conditions.PartnersItem4: Both parties must honour the commitments set out in the contract.
Conditions.ForeignText: Those who reside outside Canada and wish to take part in the forum must cover all costs related to travelling to Canada: visa procedures, plane ticket, hotel, meals, etc.
Conditions.VisaP1: We cover meals for all participants registered for November 26, as well as those registered for November 27 and 28, 2026. However, meals outside these periods, accommodation, and visa procedures remain each participant's responsibility.
Conditions.VisaP2: Once your registration is complete, we will send you a letter confirming your FISD registration along with a copy of the invoice for your registration fees, so you can begin the process of obtaining a visa if needed.
Conditions.ImageRightsText: As a FISD participant or panelist, you agree to be photographed, filmed or recorded for promotional purposes on behalf of Jeunes Solidaires and the International Forum for Solidarity and Development (FISD).
